points.point: Is it still loading / why no post after adding Text context
points.sentence: Adding text context does not make a post on its own.

points.point: What to do / check source finished loading
points.sentence: First check that the source finished loading and that its checkbox is selected in Context.

points.point: How to get the post made
points.sentence: Then type this in the AI Agent prompt box: "Create 1 LinkedIn post from my selected context. Keep it as a draft." Put your own destination in place of LinkedIn.

verdict.reason: The customer added Text context and no post appeared, and this entry states that Text context does not generate a post by itself and explains how to get one.
